text:
lina: Quick rebaseline proposal — we should break the launch into Phase A (hosted SaaS MVP) and Phase B (dedicated/private features). Phase A ships core gen + embeddings + rollout controls; Phase B picks up tenant routing, advanced batching, and Dedicated autoscale. Thoughts?

mike: +1 on phasing. infra still has the autoscale refactor and kv-cache perf work. can we move Phase A target to 2025-12-01 so we get a full regression pass? :thinking:

anya: We have one mid-market customer asking specifically for tenant routing, but they said they can wait for Phase B if we commit a Beta preview. Recommend gating Beta on privacy review.

david: SRE note — need at least 3 weeks for chaos + GA runbook verification. If Phase A is 12/01, canary should start ~11/20. Also need a rollback plan for model fallback.

lucy: From customer success: a couple of pilots (Customer X + Y) want reserved capacity earlier. Could we offer them an opt-in early Dedicated Beta (support SLA TBD) to keep them from pausing procurement?

lina: That sounds workable. Proposed new dates:
```
Phase A (MVP hosted): 2025-12-01 - public opt-in canary 2025-11-20
Phase B (Dedicated/private): 2026-02-15 - ramp through Q1
```
Must-haves for Phase A (shipping):
- generation API (streaming + structured output)
- embeddings endpoint
- basic rollout controls and model pinning
- cost/latency dashboard (per-route)

Phase B (deferred to later):
- tenant routing and per-tenant capacity policies
- Dedicated autoscale + reserved pools UX
- advanced batching/caching advisor
- enterprise KMS/HSM onboarding flow

mike: That must-haves split looks sane. Only ask: can we scope the rollout controls to a minimal set (percentage rollout + immediate kill switch) for A and leave advanced traffic shaping for B?

anya: Agree. Also we should capture launch criteria: 99th p99 latency SLO for < 2s on short prompts, < 5% regression vs current model for quality on evaluation suite, and capacity to support 3 concurrent pilots at committed throughput.

david: Add runbook acceptance + automated alerts to launch criteria. We need pre-runbook dry-run.

lucy: I'll collect pilot commitments and confirm if early Dedicated Beta is necessary; will update by EOD.

lina: Cool — I'll update the spec and send a short PR for the Phase A cut list. Quick sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to finalize dates. @mike @anya @david please bring explicit risks. :white_check_mark:

launch-bot: Meeting scheduled: Product rebaseline & launch phases — Tomorrow 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent).
